assessment: Qualified for supervised background drafting. The model abstains (needs_evidence) when the packet lacks the file that supports a claim and names exactly what it needs; when the packet is complete it returns a clean present-tense draft with correctly ranged claims that passes voice-lint.sh. Cost: ~13-20 s per section on the GPU service, ~2-4k prompt tokens. Packets must carry the mapping evidence (e.g. package.json for a script name), the ADR section for the why, and a known_gaps line saying non-blocking gaps go in requests rather than withholding prose. Independent range checking by the session model remains mandatory.
reader_text_sample: The root `package.json` maps the `verify` script to `bash scripts/verify.sh` [S2]. This script executes every repository gate in sequence, collecting outcomes rather than stopping at the first failure [S1]. The gates cover control-plane tests and typecheck, Foreman tests with coverage and dependency rules, seven enclosure tool suites, Caddyfile and compose validation, the diagram corpus, ADR records, and header lint [S1]. ADR-028 establishes this single command as the standard verification entry point, replacing a previous list of disparate checks [A1]. The tenant suite is excluded because it runs only inside the tenant image [S1]. If Docker is absent and `SKIP_DOCKER` is not set, the container-dependent gates fail explicitly [S1]. The script exits with status 0 only when no gates failed; otherwise it exits with status 1 [S1].
